source.title: Controlled classroom workover episode generator
source.license: Sensor data are original controlled synthetic teaching fixtures. BSEE link supplies real context only, not the generated sensor data.

scope: Synthetic phase-labelled monitoring; labels do not establish physical fault diagnosis or field alert thresholds.

model.name: Fitted phase-conditioned causal AR(2) + residual EWMA monitor
model.featureFormula: lag residual=observed[t-lag]-phaseMeans[currentPhase] only if lag phase matches; else0; excludes current observed target

monitor.formula: z_t=(observed_t-predicted_t)/trainingResidualSD[phase_t]; u_t=.3*z_t+.7*u_(t-1); score_t=max(abs(u_t)); alarm after3 consecutive score>=2.5
monitor.calibration: Phase means, X/Y scalers and residual SD use normal training episodes only. Threshold/persistence predeclared teaching settings.

records.scope: controlled synthetic episode; injected labels, no field sensor record

display.parameterBoundary: All levels and fault amplitudes are teaching fixtures, not operating limits.

validation.split: 12 normal training,6 validation,8 held-out complete episodes; seeds and entire histories isolated
validation.metric: held-out injected-event recall (0..1); false alarms and delays separately reported
validation.boundary: Detection must begin inside the injected event; after-event starts count as false alarms, not advance warning. Simulated results only.

sources.license: Sensor data are original controlled synthetic teaching fixtures. BSEE link supplies real context only, not the generated sensor data.

assumptions: No future sample, centered window or anomaly label enters model inputs.
Current phase is supplied process context, not inferred from injected labels.
Normal stage offsets and all magnitudes are declared generator fixtures, never field safety limits.
Brief spikes and any detector failures are retained.
provenance.parityConvention: expected = expectedRaw * outputScale + outputMean; before UI settings

serializationParity.implementation: independent NumPy forward pass on exported coefficients
